✨ Maya | Swift
🎯 Primary Use Case: Transforming raw iPhone screen recordings into professional, shareable video content for marketing, social media, and tutorials.
✨ Key Features: • Device framing with multiple iPhone/iPad/MacBook models and color variants • Customizable generic frames and no-frame option • Configurable canvas aspect ratios (1:1, 9:16, 4:5, etc.) • Optional drop shadows
📖 Summary: Maya is a native macOS application designed to enhance iPhone screen recordings by adding professional visual elements. It allows users to wrap recordings in device frames, incorporate cinematic zoom effects, add visible tap feedback, and export polished videos suitable for marketing, social media, or tutorials.
